Done. Rooms now have a topic.

**Storage** — `db/changes/20260823103000_add_topic_to_rooms.rb` adds a nullable `topic` string column to `rooms` (schema.rb regenerated by running the migration).

**Model** (`platform/core/entities/room.rb`)
- `MAX_TOPIC_LENGTH = 120` with `validates :topic, length: { maximum: 120 }` — nil and blank pass, so a room without a topic stays valid.
- `normalizes :topic` strips surrounding whitespace and stores a blank topic as `nil`, so clearing the field removes the topic rather than saving `""`. Length is measured after stripping.

**Same screen, same request as renaming** — the topic field lives in `rooms/layouts/_form.html.erb`, the form shared by the open- and closed-room new/edit screens, right under the name field and behind the same `can_administer?` check. It submits as `room[topic]` in the existing PATCH/POST, and `RoomsController#room_params` now permits `:topic`. Non-admins, who see the name as static text, see the topic the same way. Direct rooms have no rename screen, so they get no topic UI.

**Rejecting over-long topics** — `Rooms::OpensController` and `Rooms::ClosedsController` previously used `create!`/`update!`, which would have turned a rejected topic into a 500. They now re-render the form with `422 Unprocessable Content`, keeping what was typed, with the error shown next to the field and the usual flash alert. Nothing is saved and, in the closed-room case, memberships are left untouched since the revision only runs after a successful update. The input also carries `maxlength="120"` so the browser stops it earlier; the server check is what enforces it.

**Display** — the topic renders next to the room name in the room's nav bar (`room__topic`, styled in `sidebar.css`), truncated with an ellipsis and hidden on narrow viewports so the name always keeps its space.

**Tests** — 13 new tests covering optionality, the 120-character boundary, blank/whitespace normalization, setting and clearing a topic through the rename request, rejection on both create and update for open and closed rooms, and the topic appearing on the room page. Full suite: 361 runs, 0 failures, 0 errors (2 pre-existing skips); RuboCop clean.
